{{recipe}}
==Ingredients==
* 4 sheets of [[Cookbook:Matzo|matzah]]
* 1 [[Cookbook:Pound|lb]] (450 [[Cookbook:Gram|g]]) [[Cookbook:Cottage Cheese|cottage cheese]]
* 1 ¼ [[Cookbook:Cup|cups]] [[Cookbook:Grater|grated]] [[Cookbook:Mozzarella Cheese|mozzarella cheese]]
* ½ cup grated [[Cookbook:Parmesan Cheese|Parmesan cheese]]
* ½ [[Cookbook:Teaspoon|teaspoon]] [[Cookbook:Pepper|black pepper]] (optional)
* 30–34 [[Cookbook:Ounce|ounces]] [[Cookbook:Marinara Sauce|marinara sauce]] or tomato sauce

==Procedure==
# Grease a baking pan that will fit the matzah sheets.
# Spread about ½ cup sauce in the pan to cover the bottom.
# Place 1 matzoh sheet on top.
# Spread more tomato sauce over the matzah.
# Spread a layer of cottage cheese on top of the matzah.
# Sprinkle with mozzarella and Parmesan cheeses.
# Repeat these layers until all 4 matzah sheets are used.
# Spread tomato sauce and sprinkle mozzarella and Parmesan cheese on top.
# Add ½ cup water
# Cover with [[Cookbook:Aluminium Foil|foil]], and [[Cookbook:Baking|bake]] at 350°F (175°C) for 35–40 minutes.
